key_concepts: A force can move an object at rest
A force can stop a moving object
A force can change the direction of a moving object
A force can change an object's speed
Forces can change the shape of soft objects
Objects can be stretched, bent, twisted, and squeezed
Rigid objects may need a bigger force to move
Soft objects such as clay and rubber bands change shape when force is applied
The amount of force applied can be small, medium, or big
Predictions about forces can be compared with observations
